title: Online Evidence-Containment Prediction over Text Spans under Distinct Queries
abstract: arXiv:2610.41384v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evidence-grounded NLP systems often verify nested text regions sequentially, so verifying one region constrains others. We formalize this as Online Evidence-Containment Prediction (OECP): each candidate is predicted before exact verification and queried at most once. Span containment is exactly a triangular 2D product order, making OECP distinct-query online isotonic regression. With multiple admissible targets, worst-case regret is near-linear, $\widetilde{\Theta}(m_{\mathrm{eff}})$, in the effective scale given by endpoint-rank compression; a single fixed target, as in standard QA, admits an explicit polynomial-time learner with optimal $\Theta(\log m_{\mathrm{eff}})$ regret, run on real NQ episodes. On Natural Questions, containment yields a large deductive gain plus a smaller learned gain on unresolved candidates, reproduced across two backbones and DPR hierarchies. translated_title: 不同查询下文本片段的在线证据包含预测
translated_abstract: 基于证据的NLP系统通常需要按顺序验证嵌套的文本区域，因此对一个区域的验证会约束其他区域的验证。我们将这一问题形式化为在线证据包含预测（OECP）：每个候选片段在精确验证之前先进行预测，且最多被查询一次。片段包含关系恰好构成一个三角形的二维乘积序，这使得OECP成为不同查询设定下的在线保序回归。在存在多个可容许目标的情况下，最坏情况后悔度为近线性的 $\widetilde{\Theta}(m_{\mathrm{eff}})$，其中有效规模由端点秩压缩给出；而对于单一固定目标（如标准问答任务），存在一个显式的多项式时间学习器，其后悔度达到最优的 $\Theta(\log m_{\mathrm{eff}})$，并在真实的Natural Questions（NQ）回合上运行验证。在Natural Questions数据集上，包含关系带来了较大的演绎收益，加上在未解决候选上较小的学习收益，该结果在两个骨干网络和DPR层次结构上均得到复现。期望搜索空间缩减（ESR）将这些概率转化为
tldr: 该论文将嵌套文本片段的顺序验证形式化为在线证据包含预测（OECP）问题，证明其等价于不同查询下的在线保序回归，并给出多目标情形近线性后悔界与单固定目标情形最优对数后悔界的多项式时间学习器，在Natural Questions上验证了演绎与学习收益。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes sequential verification of nested text spans as Online Evidence-Containment Prediction (OECP), showing it is distinct-query online isotonic regression over a triangular 2D product order, with near-linear regret for multiple admissible targets and an optimal polynomial-time learner achieving Θ(log m_eff) regret for a single fixed target, validated on Natural Questions.
